facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-7104 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 August 2025 an incident occurred on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
